name: Big Thinkers
scope: Yes if it is a defining work or teaching of a great philosopher
boundary: Big Thinkers owns philosophy; scientific discoveries go to Eureka Moments, and the founding of religions to Faith Founded.
example_beats: Descartes: I think, therefore I am (1637)
notes: One beat per thinker, dated to their defining work or teaching, spread across East and West and from the ancients to the present.
